name: paper-writing-agents
description: Nine-agent orchestrator for fast academic paper writing in Fabian's voice. Auto-triggers on .tex / paper drafts; runs scoped review, drafting, polishing, results-figure (matplotlib) and method-diagram (drawio XML) passes; grounds every factual claim through a closed-set facts ledger, a deterministic gate, and a scoped fact-verifier; persists plans across sessions for billing-window resumption.
